messages:
nova_sales: Quick heads-up 11 Greenfield RFI due tomorrow. We need: final capability matrix (tech cells), short security FAQ, and a POC scope paragraph. Who can take which piece?

emily_se: I can finish the tech cells. I have recent perf runs for the 4k token workload and embedding bulk numbers. Will paste a small table here in a bit.

rana_security: Ill draft the security FAQ. Two clarifications I need from client: (1) do they require BYOK or is CMK acceptable? (2) retention window for logs (they wrote "industry standard"). If you have answers I can lock language.

ben_ops: For POC scope I can write the infra steps and timeline. Note: Dedicated POC needs 72h lead for infra plus a day for smoke tests. Private/onprem will be longer, call out 23 weeks.

nova_sales: BYOK preferred per RFI (section 4.2). Log retention they want 90 days for audit logs and 14 days for request traces. Use that.

emily_se: Perf snippet:```
scenario,99th_latency_ms,tokens_per_sec,embeddings/sec
hosted-eu,310,420,280
dedicated-eu (1xA100),260,680,520
private-onprem,290,600,500
```

emily_se: I'll also mark rows for streaming, function-calls, rollout controls, and quantization support. For quantization: we support INT8 and custom profiles as a billable add-on.

rana_security: Sec FAQ bullets I'll include: SOC2 Type II (attach cert), TLS1.2+, AES256 at rest, KMS integrations, customer key rotation docs, VPC peering support, and SOC2/ISO contact for audits. I'll attach the SOC2 PDF and a short KMS note.

legal_bot: Reminder: include link to Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and redwood standard T&Cs. If customer wants EU-only processing, flag legal for export controls.

ben_ops: POC timeline paragraph (draft): "Two-week evaluation across 3 deployment modes (hosted EU, Dedicated EU reserved node, Private VPC). Redwood will provision Dedicated within 5 business days after signed SOW and payment. Acceptance criteria: functional parity, 95th latency <350ms (512 tokens), embeddings >=200/sec, and logging ingestion verified."

nova_sales: Perfect. Action owners: emily -> update matrix + paste full CSV into sheet; rana -> security FAQ + SOC2 PDF; ben -> POC paragraph + runbook link; I'll assemble and send to buyer and cc legal. Target: send by 09:00 UTC tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Document uploaded: soc2-redwood-2025.pdf -> /assets/security/soc2-redwood-2025.pdf

emily_se: One more note: customer asked about sample SLA for Dedicated. I have a short blurb: 99.5% uptime SLA for reserved capacity, latency SLOs depend on model family. I'll add to matrix under 'SLA/SLO'.

rana_security: Also add a note about penetration testing schedule and offer to share a redacted report under NDA.

nova_sales: Great. I'll collect these pieces and do a final pass. If anyone updates the drive please ping me. Thanks!
